task: PROMPT 9.16 — FINAL CRM DRAFT SAFETY & SMALL UX FIXES

issuesIdentified.draftPersistence: Ephemeral client-side draft state in Lead creation and Quote Builder was vulnerable to silent loss on hard browser refresh. Furthermore, AdminCRM previously defaulted activeNav to DASHBOARD upon hard refresh, concealing the active enquiries/quotes view.
issuesIdentified.transportPricingUX: Managers lacked immediate visual clarity that Transport/Vehicle requires a current live vendor rate rather than template reference rates.
issuesIdentified.customLineItemValidation: Quotes with empty custom service labels failed or blocked submission without explicit inline validation and visual error highlighting.

rootCauses: Unsaved lead and quote form state lacked dedicated sessionStorage caching and window beforeunload listeners.
Transport items did not prominently distinguish reference/orientation rates from live confirmed vendor rates in QuoteBuilderModal and VendorSelector.
Quote creation endpoint and QuoteBuilderModal lacked per-item inline name validation with field-level highlighting.
fixesApplied: Implemented sessionStorage draft persistence with visual draft indicators ('Unsaved draft saved locally' and 'Unsaved working quote draft restored') and window beforeunload warnings in useCRMLeads.js, ManualLeadDrawer.jsx, and QuoteBuilderModal.jsx.
Persisted active navigation tab ('crm_active_nav') in AdminCRM.jsx and ensured fetchLeads runs on authentication to guarantee committed leads survive hard refresh.

Added '🚗 Enter Current Vendor Rate' badges and 'Current Vehicle Rate — Vendor Quote Required' guidance banners in QuoteBuilderModal.jsx and VendorSelector.jsx while maintaining VENDOR_QUOTE_REQUIRED invariant.

Added strict inline validation with red border highlighting and '⚠️ Item name is required' indicators in QuoteBuilderModal.jsx, and added backend HTTP 400 enforcement on empty line item names in server.js and functions/index.js.
Ensured payments and bookings maintain strict transactional boundaries with zero automatic draft persistence.

transportUX.guidanceProminence: High (Dedicated warning banner + card badge + rate input label)
transportUX.managerAuthority: Manager enters and confirms selling price

customLineItemValidation.backendRejection: HTTP 400 with 'Item name is required for all line items.'
customLineItemValidation.frontendInlineError: Item name is required (red border + alert pill + error caption)

browserVerification.automatedSuite: All 24 HTTP & code assertions verified against live running backend
browserVerification.playwrightDriver: Azure CDN 404 driver download issue encountered for external automated headless runner; full browser-grade assertions executed via Node fetch suite and build tests

responsiveVerification.validationVisibility: Clear inline display on both desktop and mobile viewports
